about: The Superior Winter Festival is a downtown holiday party in Superior.
It is Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 2 to 5 PM.
The Superior Chamber, the Town of Superior and Blue Sport Stable host it.
Activities center on Main Street and Superior Drive.
Kids can meet Santa for a keepsake photo by a professional photographer.
The Grinch Experience and the reindeer encounter run all afternoon.
A hayride circles downtown.
The Elf Express station lets kids write or paint letters to Santa.
S'mores kits and fire pits sit beside a hot cocoa bar.
Face painting is free for attendees.
Skate with Santa runs 3 to 5 PM at Blue Sport Stable.
The Superior Community Tree lighting is at 5 PM.
faq: When is the Superior Winter Festival in 2026?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 2 to 5 PM.
Where is it?
Downtown Superior, around Main Street and Superior Drive.
Can kids meet Santa?
Yes, Santa photos run from 2 to 5 PM.
When is the tree lighting?
At 5 PM, after the afternoon activities.
Is there skating?
Skate with Santa runs 3 to 5 PM at Blue Sport Stable.
Are there reindeer?
Yes, a reindeer encounter runs 2 to 5 PM.
Is face painting free?
Yes, face painting stations are free for attendees.
